method: All 100 queue entries investigated; no early stop. This report distinguishes confirmed extraction defects, independent arithmetic checks, and same-implementation source replay. It does not turn limited-scope checks into manual acceptance sign-off.

items.notes: Revenue FY2025 midpoint falls 1.06383%; GAAP EPS 3.67–3.91 to 3.67–3.77 and adjusted EPS 4.20–4.45 to 4.20–4.30 were omitted. Revenue plus EPS meets the existing multi-metric small-cut rule. Run81 NOT_DETERIORATED is wrong.
